notes: The four boards are identical apart from colour; each image gets an entry so the art stays linked.
slots: printed labels 'GEAR' (×2, top edge, cards tuck in from above) and 'JOB or BOUNTY' (×2, bottom edge). 'JOB or BOUNTY' is one dual slot holding one card (R-14.16).
fame_track: spaces 0 to 12; the {FAME} icon is printed under space 10, the standard fame requirement (R-18.9).

reputation_tracks: left to right as printed; each track has '+' at the top and '−' at the bottom, a green upper zone, a grey centre zone marked with the faction icon and name, and a red lower zone (three states, R-10.4). The tick lines inside each zone are decoration.

verify: Colour names (green, red, yellow, white) are taken from the frame colour of the [Mod 01] images; confirm against the physical boards.

The round area with three coloured discs (centre of the board) and the black cut-out on the left carry no printed label; read here as the place for the character card (cut-out) and decoration (discs). Confirm nothing in the rules uses them.
